identified_issue: Capture and purification were linked only by a scalar CO2 flow.
technical_consequence: Purification did not receive the wet product or source impurities.
implemented_correction: Transmit wet component composition, temperature, pressure and CO2 mass flow from capture to purification.

identified_issue: Capture energy used fixed coefficients with bounded multipliers.
technical_consequence: Feed concentration and MEA solvent physics were not represented.
implemented_correction: Add MEA cyclic-capacity, reaction/sensible/vaporisation heat, blower and pump equations.
verification: Matched Papa NB01 steam, electricity and solvent cross-check.

identified_issue: MEA-specific behavior could not be distinguished from other capture methods.
technical_consequence: Technology comparisons risked applying the wrong physical response.
implemented_correction: Add process families; restrict MEA equations to MEA absorption and use separate Cryocap, oxyfuel and DMX responses.

identified_issue: Source gas composition was not an explicit model input.
technical_consequence: Gas handling, degradation and raw product quality could not respond to source data.
implemented_correction: Add documented source process inputs and per-source UI controls for CO2, H2O, O2, SOx, NOx and CO.
verification: Invalid-composition validation and UI smoke tests.

identified_issue: Purification energy was an effort multiplier rather than a stage calculation.
technical_consequence: Compression, dehydration, heat and cooling could not be reconciled.
implemented_correction: Add knockout/dehydration, impurity balance, train-family power, thermal and cooling calculations.

identified_issue: Bulk wet-feed water could be assigned directly to dryer regeneration.
technical_consequence: Molecular-sieve and TEG heat could be overstated.
implemented_correction: Condense bulk water at the dryer inlet saturation condition and regenerate only residual adsorbed water.
verification: Train B thermal comparison within approximately 2%.

identified_issue: Compression boundary was implicit.
technical_consequence: Power/CAPEX could be omitted or counted twice across blocks.
implemented_correction: Calculate multistage source-to-110-bar compression only in purification; mark capture compression false and purification true.

identified_issue: Product targets could imply a composition that cannot be made from the feed.
technical_consequence: The old screen could silently create an inert remainder.
implemented_correction: Retain only available species, report achieved composition, and flag infeasible target combinations.

identified_issue: Pipeline EOS used selected targets rather than the achieved product.
technical_consequence: Hydraulic density could be disconnected from purification.
implemented_correction: Flow-weight achieved dry product compositions into the Peng-Robinson mixture.

identified_issue: Purification CO2 loss was scalar-only.
technical_consequence: Component side streams and mass closure were not visible.
implemented_correction: Calculate product and side-stream component flows and expose balance error.
verification: Mass-balance error tests and handoff table.

identified_issue: Capture solvent and water consumption were hidden in generic OPEX.
technical_consequence: Cost and environmental sensitivities were incomplete.
implemented_correction: Calculate solvent degradation/makeup and water makeup explicitly.

identified_issue: Purification hydrogen and sorbent consumption were absent.
technical_consequence: Deoxygenation and polishing impacts were understated.
implemented_correction: Add stoichiometric hydrogen and sorbent replacement cost/emission terms.

identified_issue: Environmental results contained utilities but little process-consumable detail.
technical_consequence: Lifecycle burden could be understated.
implemented_correction: Add solvent, water, hydrogen, sorbent and annualized equipment screening burdens.

identified_issue: A more detailed method could remove comparability with historical results.
technical_consequence: Users could not distinguish model change from scenario change.
implemented_correction: Keep v0.7.3 screening as a selectable calculation fidelity and regression-test its cost boundary.

identified_issue: Process method and stage connectivity were not visible to users.
technical_consequence: The interface could not demonstrate that blocks were truly integrated.
implemented_correction: Add calculation-fidelity selector, method columns and connected handoff/balance panel.

identified_issue: Papa reference execution was notebook/manual.
technical_consequence: Results were difficult to reproduce independently.
implemented_correction: Add local, read-only reference runner with compact JSON output.

identified_issue: No matched-input numerical comparison artifact existed.
technical_consequence: Differences could not be quantified or explained.
implemented_correction: Add harmonized capture and Train A/B comparison script, CSV, JSON, plot and report.

identified_issue: Scientific changes lacked dedicated regression coverage.
technical_consequence: Future edits could break stage boundaries or technology specificity.
implemented_correction: Add nine process-model tests plus retain all existing model/UI/trajectory tests.

identified_issue: Source defaults are not plant measurements.
technical_consequence: Absolute source results retain assay uncertainty.
implemented_correction: Label every process-source input as a proxy, expose it in the UI and document replacement requirements.

identified_issue: Detailed phase equilibrium and binary interaction data remain outside the fast cluster model.
technical_consequence: Near-critical density and phase behavior require FEED verification.
implemented_correction: Retain Peng-Robinson screening EOS, achieved-composition handoff and explicit limitation; do not claim full phase-envelope validation.
verification: PR EOS regression and hydraulic constraints.
